name: sqlite-catalog-contracts-history-review
goal: SQLite catalog units declare accurate readable contracts, and history-index source changes retain committed relocation review evidence.

evidence: The feature commit adds six SQLite/catalog function manifests with derived contracts, and adds catalog output to two previously moved history modules. Expect every SQLite unit to carry a declared readable contract and each changed moved implementation to retain a review tied to its source commit.

The general contract guard reports gaps but has no targeted catalog contract scenario; the move guard detects stale definitions but does not reject omitting a review while updating the hash. Added targeted SQLite-manifest assertions and a reviewless changed-source regression case.
